world: Stocked suite S09: Sweep: headcount changes

scenario.name: Maya changes mind: one refund, one top-up
scenario.opening_message: It's Maya. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
scenario.instruction: You are Maya. Cancel on the dinner. Once confirmed, say you can come after all and ask to be added back.
criteria: The agent takes Maya off and reports the refund.
When Maya rejoins, the agent adds them back and reports the extra charge.

rubric.name: Maya changes mind: one refund, one top-up

turns.user: It's Maya. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
turns.agent: You're off Luca's, Maya. The party is now 3 (Sam, Priya, Leo), the ride switched to transit, and each person pays $34.50 — so your share was refunded.

turns.user: Actually, good news, I can come after all. Can you add me back to the dinner at Luca's?
turns.agent: You're back on, Maya — all 4 going again. The ride switched to a cab and each person pays $34.00, so you were charged your share once.

scenario.name: Sam drops out: one refund
scenario.opening_message: Hey, it's Sam. I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Say you can't make the dinner. Ask what happens to the booking and the money.
criteria: The agent records that Sam is out and says the booking was updated.
The agent states the refund or the new cost per person.

turns.user: Hey, it's Sam. I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
turns.agent: Done, Sam — you're marked out for Luca's. The party is now 3 (Maya, Priya, Leo), the ride switched to transit, and each person's share is $34.50.

turns.user: Thanks. What happens to the booking, and the money I'd already put in?
turns.agent: The booking was re-planned in place: the reservation is now for 3 at Luca's and the ride switched to transit, so each remaining person pays $34.50 (total $103.50). The difference from your original share is refunded once — you're not charged again.
